worked_solution:
From the adjacent intervals rule, we know that

$$
{\int }_{3}^{7}f(x)\,\text{d}x\,+\,{\int }_{7}^{10}f(x)\,\text{d}x\,=\,{\int }_{3}^{10}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

Plugging in the known information gives

$$
0+5\,=\,{\int }_{3}^{10}f(x)\,\text{d}x\,⇒\,{\int }_{3}^{10}f(x)\,\text{d}x=5.
$$

Finally, compute the desired integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{3}^{10}(3f(x)-4)\,\text{d}x & =3{\int }_{3}^{10}f(x)\,\text{d}x\,-\,4{\int }_{3}^{10}1\,\text{d}x \\  & =3(5)\,-\,4\cdot x{|}_{3}^{10} \\  & =15\,-\,4(10-3) \\  & =15-28 \\  & =-13\end{aligned}
$$
